adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the activity table matrix, source-reviewed linked database rows, and replaced framework-only adjudication with a source-reviewed final decision. The paper is accepted with cautions, not clean acceptance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: 221 linked database rows remain source_conflict/database-summary cautions because they are database-only aggregates, figure-only toxicity values, strain-mismatched rows, or row-level values not exactly matched to primary tables.
Membrane permeabilization is source-supported; nucleic-acid binding/aggregation language is preserved as hypothesis and not promoted to direct mechanism.
Local supplementary zip contains a PDF with permeability ANOVA tables; no additional activity/toxicity spreadsheet was present in local material.

materials_exhausted.note: Local source surfaces needed for worker-2/4/6 gate result were opened; no absent external supplement is required for current acceptance with cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked APD6/DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows were rechecked against Table 1, primary activity tables, result text, and article metadata. Source-verified rows carry primary locators; database-only/aggregate/strain-conflicted rows remain explicit source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered 285 source-located activity/toxicity records, including the previously missing Table 4 MBIC/MBEC matrix. No activity table parser issue remains.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 final mechanism keeps direct membrane-permeability evidence separate from phenotype-level antibiofilm activity and discussion-level hypotheses.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_final_review: Acceptance depends on strict semantic and publication-quality gates and a closed rework response; no open rework target remains when publication_grade is true.
